## Bug Report (auto-generated from user feedback)

### Description
Users are reporting that meetings are failing to record completely on macOS. The system either splits a single meeting into multiple partial meetings, or only captures a small fraction of the total meeting time (e.g. 9 minutes out of a 30-minute meeting) when exporting transcripts via pipes.

Note: Similar issues were reported in #2446 and #2520 but were closed. The problem appears to still be occurring in version 2.2.296.

### Environment
- OS: macos 15.7.5
- App version: 2.2.296
- Affected users: Multiple users reporting

### Evidence
**User feedback 1:**
> Somehow this was detected as two meetings (per my previous log submission) but only recorded a few min in each

**User feedback 2:**
> My most recent meeting failed to record the whole thing again :( it shows audio recorded in the UI but when I use my pipe to export the full transcript it only detected about 9min of the 30min meeting

### Frequency
- Feedback reports: 2 (recently)
